title: Tender submission readiness evidence review
source_text:
# Synthetic tender conditions and applicant record

Tender requirements:
Clause 1: Tender submissions must be received by 11:00 SAST on 28 August 2026.
Clause 2: A valid tax-status PIN is mandatory.
Clause 3: Three signed project references are mandatory.
Clause 4: Pricing schedule Form C must be signed by an authorised director.
Clause 5: A compulsory briefing attendance certificate must be included.

evidence.text: The tender notice lists a closing time of 11:00 SAST on 28 August 2026.
A tax-status PIN is included, but validity has not been verified.
Two signed project reference letters are supplied; a third is not included.
Pricing schedule Form C is unsigned in the supplied packet.
A compulsory briefing attendance certificate is included.
